mapper.select: SELECT answer_number, content, content_format, is_correct, explanation, explanation_format, question_id, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.answers WHERE question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY answer_number
INSERT INTO edu.answers (question_id, content, is_correct, explanation, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{content}, #{isCorrect}, #{explanation}, NOW(), NOW()) RETURNING answer_number
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.answers SET content = #{content}, is_correct = #{isCorrect}, explanation = #{explanation}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE answer_number = #{answerNumber} AND question_id = #{questionId}
